content: Let $y=y(x)$ be the solution of the differential equation $\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{~d} x}+2 y \sec ^2 x=2 \sec ^2 x+3 \tan x \cdot \sec ^2 x$ such that $y(0)=\frac{5}{4}$. Then $12\left(y\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\mathrm{e}^{-2}\right)$ is equal to_____________________
